issues.description: deletePhaseTransaction is ~110 lines; only trivial filter edits in this range, so not a refactor trigger. Phase path emits changed:["phase"] and has no project filter, so it is not identical to the project helper; split opportunistically on next non-trivial touch.
Column-less release does not bump version (parity with old tracker behavior). A client holding the item with stale project_id/phase_id can still write without 409. Decide in T21 or a follow-up.

assertNoBoardArtifacts filters card_events by card_id IS NOT NULL, so duplicate project/phase events from a racing delete are no longer detected; consider asserting exact tracker_project_deleted/tracker_phase_deleted event counts.
Empty no-phase bucket yields positionBetween(null,null) = 1024; the re-bucket loop issues one UPDATE per item and does not rebalance on RangeError. Matches old behavior.
Formatter-only rewraps in both concurrency test files add diff noise unrelated to the task.
